citeAs: Chen, C., Liu, M., Codella, N., Li, Y., Yuan, L., & Gurari, D. (2024). Fully Authentic Visual Question Answering Dataset from Online Communities. arXiv preprint arXiv:2311.15562v4.
creator: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, Danna Gurari (University of Texas at Austin, Microsoft, University of Colorado Boulder)
description: VQAonline is the first Visual Question Answering (VQA) dataset in which all contents originate from an authentic use case, sourced from online question answering community forums (Stack Exchange). It features lengthy answers and authentic context.
name: VQAonline
publisher: University of Texas at Austin, Microsoft, University of Colorado Boulder
rai:annotatorDemographics: Stack Exchange users. The geographic representation is unbalanced, with more from countries like US, India, Europe and less from countries like Egypt. It may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas without access to mobile devices and internet.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Data was collected from Stack Exchange users via user entry interactions. The question was collected as the post title, the image as a URL link, and the context via a body text entry field. Individuals who posted the visual questions marked which answer was the 'accepted answer'.
rai:dataBiases: The dataset may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas since VQAs are posted by Stack Exchange users with access to mobile devices and Internet. Additionally, the geographic representation of Stack Exchange is unbalanced, with more from countries like US, India, Europe and less from countries like Egypt.
rai:dataCollection: Created by scraping publicly-available data from the online question-answering platform Stack Exchange, spanning from August 2010 to November 2022. Collected examples containing a natural language question, context, an image, and at least one accepted answer.
rai:dataLimitations: Geographic imbalance and underrepresentation of people in poverty-stricken areas without internet access.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Converted all images to png format for data format consistency.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Removed visual questions with scores 0 or less for either the question or answer. Excluded visual questions with multiple images (e.g., GIF) or with visual answers. Removed examples for which the image could not be downloaded. Converted all images to png format.
rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking VQA models, real-world applications including community question answering platforms, learning assistance VQA tools for children, virtual assistants, visual dialog and query, and visual search and browsing.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Utilized the state-of-the-art text spotter model DeepSolo to detect text for all images in the dataset.

null_reasons.rai:dataImputationProtocol: No data imputation protocol is described in the paper.
null_reasons.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: No maintenance or update plan is mentioned.
null_reasons.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No discussion of personal or sensitive information collection.
null_reasons.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: No explicit discussion of handling missing data other than filtering out broken links.
null_reasons.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data is just the Stack Exchange XML dump, already covered in data collection.
null_reasons.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: No inter-annotator agreement metrics for the dataset creation itself (only for model evaluation).
null_reasons.rai:annotationsPerItem: The dataset uses the single 'accepted answer' per question, though there are 1.45 answers on average. Not a standard multi-annotator setup.
null_reasons.rai:dataSocialImpact: Only generic statements about helping create human-centered VQA models.
